To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the cooperation between AI and QC will be possible if and only if the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) the development of quantum computers that are able to process information in a reversible manner, and (b) the development of a quantum version of the Turing Machine.

(a) the biological brain is an example of a highly efficient parallel and low energy consumption system; (b) quantum computers are also highly efficient parallel and very low energy consumption systems; and (c) artificial neural networks are highly efficient parallel and medium energy consumption systems.

the combination of AI and QC could lead to the development of a new class of intelligent systems, which will be able to perform at a much faster rate, with a higher level of parallelism, consuming less energy than the systems we have nowadays.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the potential of quantum computing to improve the efficiency of artificial intelligence systems.

the identification of the common characteristics of both artificial neural networks and the quantum circuit model that may lead to the creation of a new generation of intelligent systems that will have the ability to perform in a faster, more accurate and efficient way than the current state-of-the-art.
the possibility of using quantum computing as a tool in the design of intelligent systems, in order to increase their efficiency in terms of speed and energy consumption.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the answer to the question “Can artificial intelligence benefit of quantum computing?” is “yes” but, as we will show along this paper, the answer is not as straightforward as it may look at first glance.
the combination of both areas will not be a trivial task.
, at the current stage, it is difficult to determine if there is any real possibility of using quantum computing in order to improve artificial intelligence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the combination of both areas may eventually allow us to develop a new generation of intelligent systems, which are able to perform at least some of the tasks that are currently performed by biological brains, but with a significantly reduced energy consumption.

the combination of artificial intelligence and quantum computation may lead us to a new generation of intelligent systems with the potential to solve problems that are currently out of reach for our computers and/or our brains.

the cooperation between both areas could lead to a more efficient and powerful artificial intelligence, with a lower energy consumption and a higher speed of execution, which is the main goal of this paper.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, although the quantum computer is a powerful machine, it will not solve all the AI problems, and vice versa, AI will not be able to take advantage of quantum computing in all the cases.
the cooperation of AI with QC can lead to a significant increase in the efficiency of the former.
, in spite of the fact that quantum computers are still in the research phase, the basic concepts of quantum computing can already be used in the design of new algorithms for artificial intelligence.
